spans.s: रित् (1) characterized by the mute consonant र् signifying the acute accent for the penultimate vowel;cf. उपोत्तमं रिति P. VI.
; ( 2 ) the same as रिफित or रेफि, a visarga which is changeable into र् when euphonically combined; cf. विसर्जनीयो रिफितः V.Pr.
; cf. also भाव्युपधं च रिद्विसर्जनीयान्तानि रेफेण ; V.Pr.
. The terms रिफित, रेफि and रित् are given in the Padapāțha to a पद or word which ends in a Visarga which has originated from र् in the Samhitāpātha; e. g. the Visarga in कः, प्रात: etc.; cf. R.Pr.
